style.name: Cinder Veil
style.silhouette: heavy cowls and long split mantles
style.style_block: Dark smoky oil painting with visible hog-bristle marks, thick scraped impasto on lit cloth and lost-and-found shadow edges; no uniform outline. Great pale cowls and long split mantles form weighted triangular silhouettes with bent knees. Coal plum, burnt umber and warm ash dominate; bone-white cloth and small saturated elemental light puncture the darkness. Equipment is battered blackened bronze, heat-clouded glass and charred wood. Enemies are weighty smoky forms with hard lit weapon edges; wardstones are slag-like stone with luminous cracks. Ground is a low-detail dark ash field rubbed with soot. The portrait is layered dark oil, intensely lit weathered face, visible brush ridges, water glow in the shadows and an ornate blackened metal frame.
